title: Dead-estate pointers in RUNTIME SOURCE outside deployment/azure — system-status.ts hard-codes secuura-staging-* hosts, westeurope and a dead URL suffix
description:
## BLUF

KS-490 (3) / PR #852 closed every dead-estate pointer under `deployment/azure` — **6 of 6, and that claim is correct for that directory.** The class does not stop there: it extends into `services/`, where the pointers sit in **runtime source**, not in a template nobody consumes.

Found by the KS-490 (3) tier-2 gate. **Pre-existing at the merge base — not a defect in #852.**

## Measured

`services/api-gateway/src/routes/system-status.ts` at `:48`, `:232`, `:243`, `:254` hard-codes `secuura-staging-{issuer,verifier,admin}`, `westeurope`, and the dead URL suffix `ashypond-b460d1a1`.

These are **not** among the 11 documentation files excluded from #852's scope as prose — this is code that runs.

## Why it is a different shape from #852's work

The `deployment/azure` parameters files are consumed by nothing (`deploy.sh` passes every value inline). These strings are served to callers by a live endpoint, so they are wrong in a way a reader can actually see.

## Acceptance

`system-status.ts` reports hosts and region from configuration or from the live deployment identity, not from literals naming a subscription decommissioned 2026-06-25. Values read from the client `CLAUDE.md` / `deploy-demo.yml` at edit time and quoted. No `az` call.

- **The change:** the stub in `ks864f-a-red-frontend-makes-the-headline-degraded.test.ts` gets a set of hostnames for which `fetch` rejects, and three cells (+15 -1): with the issuer, the verifier or the admin portal alone unreachable, that portal reads `unreachable`, the other two read healthy, and the headline reads `degraded`.
- **Proof, measured by Seat T 14th:** the cells pin existing behaviour, so they pass on develop by design. They go red under the gate's two named mutants of `allFrontendsHealthy` (3 of 11 cells red under each, by assertion), and five tampers of the new test lines are all killed. Whole api-gateway suite 165 files, 1738 of 1738 with the change (1735 of 1735 before).

It builds items 1 to 4 of this ticket's open list (comment 9e09ce85). The api-gateway deploy is owed, and that comment says this ticket stays open until api-gateway is deployed and read live. This comment says what is merged and what is owed, not that the ticket is fixed.

- What merged (PR API, seven files): `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/system-status.ts` (58 lines changed), four tests (`ks864b` and `ks864d` edited, `ks864e` +139 and `ks864f` +105 new), and two Projects Documents fragments.
- Read at source, `system-status.ts`, parent then squash: `secuura-staging` 18 then 0; `az containerapp` 1 then 0; `:8080` 0 then 4; `getServiceUrl(` 18 then 18. A string in neither file (`zzqq-s28-ctl`) counts 0 and 0, and `getServiceUrl(` counting 18 shows the search reads the file. Not run.
- Not on the Kintsugi pin Wednesday names (Seat D 56th's REVISION head e174f5eb488a): in my own shallow clone of develop that pin is an ancestor of this squash (rc 0) and this squash is not an ancestor of the pin (rc 1); the control, the KS-2009 squash 31ef48b54614, reads rc 0 the other way. * **Item 1:** the 17 unused third arguments are gone and the URL helper takes two parameters. Counted at develop `1b1b65c7415f`: 18 call sites, 17 of them passed a third argument (the "16 of 18" on the 2026-11-03 comment contradicts its own second figure, 18 appearances less the one hint).

* **Item 3:** the three portal defaults go from :80 to :8080, the port every frontend listens on and nginx proxies to, so a serving portal reads healthy instead of unreachable. The portal `url` is in the unauthenticated body, which is why this is tier 1.
* **Item 4:** a frontend-category service that is not healthy makes the headline degraded; the status page is untouched. The reader census Wednesday set as the condition is in the PR body: no reader newly faults on a red portal; monitors outside the tree are UNMEASURED.

## BLUF
PR #1009 (the #1007 QA gate's F-1007-1 test-only follow-up) **merged** as squash `d067725ff1c7f036dbf0f726b9bf12f4daefebe7` on develop (single parent `f7c2f4acb28875e3665a61c8eaaad5c54bd3aa55`), on Wednesday's GO naming head `6ec0cb19834407887daa7bf5994f2da169abd30e` after a tier-2 QA gate (round 1) returned GO WITH FINDINGS. **F-1007-1 is closed.** This ticket stays open and goes back to **Backlog**: items 2 and 3, the 17 call-site arguments and the `:527` hint are not addressed. Two Polish findings from that gate stay open here (below).

## Recommendation
No build owed from this merge. F-1009-1 and F-1009-2 are routed as a separate test-only brief, not a PR on this head.

## Detail
**Merge, verified at origin:** develop tip = `d067725ff`; one parent = `f7c2f4acb`; tree `bf52d4674` = the predicted merge tree; files base..merge = the PR's three api-gateway tests, each equal to the gated head: `ks864a-dead-estate-helper.test.ts` `6d119d23d`, `ks864b-dead-estate-portals.test.ts` `3cfb1da89`, `ks864c-portal-env-vars.test.ts` `f886bdadf`. The link to this ticket read `contributes` before the merge, with 0 closing phrases in the PR title, body, comments, commit message and squash message.

Gate report: `Testing Agent MAIN/projects/secuura/reports/2026-09-17-ks864-1009-6ec0cb198-tier2-r1/report.md`. Findings: 0 Blocker, 0 Major, 0 Minor, 2 Polish, 8 Records.

**F-1007-1 closed by #1009.** Each G-2 tamper (issuer, verifier, admin) compiles (`tsc -p .` rc 0) and reds exactly its own portal's two ks864c cells (staging and development) and nothing else in the whole api-gateway suite (46 files / 397 tests at head; 47 / 400 on the merged tree with develop `f7c2f4acb`).

**Coverage residuals (R-1), each measured at 0 reds:** no cell pins the `_PORTAL_URL` env-var arm under production, test, unset, dev or demo; nor the empty-string arm (`||` vs `??`); nor the default arm under development.

**R-3:** the api-gateway suite needs `isolate: true`. ks864a and ks864b do not `vi.resetModules()`, so a run without isolation reads a cached module (order-flaky, at the base too).

**R-4:** seat A's including-tsc figures for this PR (53 → 47, TS2741 ×2) were NOT reproduced by the gate. The gate's including program read 34 → 30 with 0 TS2741. Two installed copies of the Node type definitions (the `types/node` package) are the gate's hypothesis, not proven.

**Open Polish (not built here):**
- **F-1009-1:** both ks864c blocks set IDENTICAL values, so `vi.resetModules()` is not pinned. Removing it reds 0 and hides a development-only regression. Fix shape: distinct values per block.
- **F-1009-2:** a block's `NODE_ENV` is never asserted. Removing the assignment reds 0, and #1007's S-B regression then no longer reaches ks864c (ks864b still catches it). Fix shape: assert the body's environment equals the block's `nodeEnv`.

Nothing deployed.

PR #1009 raises the QA gate's F-1007-1 follow-up at head `6ec0cb19834407887daa7bf5994f2da169abd30e`, not yet merged. Test only. It pins each portal's env-var arm (`ISSUER_`/`VERIFIER_`/`ADMIN_PORTAL_URL`) under `NODE_ENV=staging` and `development`, and takes the gate's P-1007-1 type fixes. **This ticket stays open.**

## Detail
- PR: https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1009 (branch `feature/ks-864-f1-portal-env-var-cells`, base develop `0308b7a04`).
- New `ks864c-portal-env-vars.test.ts`: 6 cells (3 portals × 2 envs), each on a freshly imported module.
- The gate's G-2 tamper per portal reddens exactly that portal's two cells, with project `tsc` rc 0 on every row.

## BLUF
PR #1007 (parts A+B) **merged** as squash `0308b7a0447a2c01c12aad358c9b4d04a5178210` on develop (parent `93629700c`); not deployed. `system-status.ts` no longer resolves URLs to the dead `secuura-staging` / `ashypond…westeurope` estate under `NODE_ENV=staging`. The tier-2 QA gate measured parity outside staging at 156 of 156 cells (dev and demo included). **This ticket stays open.** A test-only follow-up PR for the gate's F-1007-1 comes next.

## Recommendation
No action needed on the merge. Still open on this ticket:
- the 17 call-site arguments;
- the `:527` remediation hint (R-1 below);
- item 2 (portals probed on `:80` vs nginx `:8080`);
- item 3 (the headline ignores red panels).

## Detail
- Merge verified at origin: develop tip = the merge commit, single parent `93629700c`, 3 files, `system-status.ts` blob `956083916` (the gate's target).
- **F-1007-1 (Minor) → follow-up PR, part of this ticket.** No cell pins the env-var arm of the three rewritten portal expressions (`ISSUER_`/`VERIFIER_`/`ADMIN_PORTAL_URL`), under staging or outside it. The gate's compiling tamper G-2 (issuer URL hard-coded to its default) reddens 0 of 388. The behaviour itself is correct, as measured.
- **Records** (the gate's, not defects in #1007):
  - **R-1:** the `:527` hint `az containerapp revision restart --name secuura-staging-${service.name} --resource-group secuura-staging-rg` names the dead estate. It reaches **anonymous** callers in every NODE_ENV whenever a service is unhealthy. Pre-existing; part of this ticket's open item and the KS-1102 ruling.
  - **R-3:** RUNBOOK 1.2's `what-if` passes the `env.demo.json` parameter file, which has no `environment` parameter, so it evaluates the bicep default `'staging'`. Harmless as a what-if (it deploys nothing), but copied into a real `create` it would run the gateway with `NODE_ENV=staging`.
  - **R-4:** dead-estate siblings remain in `deployment/azure/configure-domain.sh` and `env.staging.example`.
- **Correction to the #1007 evidence (the gate's C-1):** seat A's tamper row "getServiceUrl ignores its env var" (`if (envUrl && false)`) does not compile (`tsc` rc 2, TS2322), so it is void as a red-proof. The gate pinned both controls with compiling tampers (G-1, Q-1), one red each.
- Report: `Testing Agent MAIN/projects/secuura/reports/2026-09-17-ks864-1007-b28ed490a-tier2-r1/report.md`.

## BLUF

- **The kintsugi deploy gate on `4554b25e2` found a second defect in the three expressions this ticket already owns.** `system-status.ts` probes the three portals on `:80`, but nginx serves them on `:8080`. So the public `/status/` page lists all three as unreachable while they serve 200.
- **The page's headline still reads "All Systems Operational"**, because it keys only on required services.
- **Recorded here rather than as a new ticket:** one config-driven rewrite of these expressions and one system-status unit pass close both (Kam's 2026-09-07 13:23 ticket rule).
- Pre-existing, found by the kintsugi deploy gate on `4554b25e2` (finding F-1, Minor).

## Recommendation

- No action needed now. The rewrite this ticket already calls for is the place to close items 2 and 3 below.

## Detail

### Item 2 — the portal probe port

- **One expression per portal.** At `4554b25e2`, `services/api-gateway/src/routes/system-status.ts` lines 231–233, 242–244 and 253–255 are each ONE expression. The issuer one reads:
  - `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'staging' ? '<the westeurope literal this ticket covers>' : (process.env.ISSUER_PORTAL_URL || 'http://issuer-frontend:80')`
  - The verifier and admin expressions have the same shape.
- **The ports disagree.** `docker/nginx-gateway/nginx-demo.conf` lines 475, 488 and 557 reach the same containers on `:8080`. `docker-compose.yml` sets none of `ISSUER_PORTAL_URL`, `VERIFIER_PORTAL_URL` or `ADMIN_PORTAL_URL`.
- **Measured by the gate on kintsugi, 2026-09-11 22:55:20Z:**
  - `GET /system/status` reports `issuer-portal`, `verifier-portal` and `admin-portal` as `unreachable` ("fetch failed").
  - `/`, `/verify/` and `/admin/` all render and serve 200 through the same gateway.
- **Fix shape (the gate's):** point the portal checks at the ports nginx actually uses, or read them from the same env nginx is configured from.
- **Regression test (the gate's):** a system-status unit cell that fails when a configured portal URL's port disagrees with the nginx upstream for that portal.

### Item 3 — the headline ignores red panels

- **Why the page stays green.** `system-status.ts:427` sets the overall status from required services and dependencies only, and `frontend/status/index.html:585` renders it. The three portals are `required: false`, so the page reads "All Systems Operational" next to "Frontend Portals 0/3".
- **Also on the page (Polish):** the troubleshooting tip says `cd services/issuer-portal && npm run dev`, a path that does not exist.

### Evidence

- **Report:** `/Volumes/DevMASTER/!CODING/Testing Agent MAIN/projects/secuura/reports/2026-09-12-kintsugi-deploy-4554b25e2-tier1-r1/report.md`, section `### F-1 — /status/ headlines "All Systems Operational" while listing three serving portals as unreachable`.
- **Supporting files:** screenshot `evidence/page-04-status.png`; wire body `evidence/wire/h2_system_status.body`.
- **Pre-existing:** `system-status.ts` was last touched 2026-06-25, and 0 files changed in `0f8fb33c3..4554b25e2`.

### Dedupe

- **Method:** a literal, case-insensitive census over all 1,089 KS issues (682 archived; title and description) and 2,946 comments (includeArchived), run 2026-09-12 by s188.
- **Completeness control:** per-ticket comment counts equal direct API reads on 9 of 9 tickets.
- **Hits:**
  - `system-status.ts`: 1 (this ticket)
  - `ISSUER_PORTAL_URL`: 0
  - `All Systems Operational`: 0
  - `issuer-frontend:80`: 0
  - `Frontend Portals`: 1 (KS-77, archived, unrelated)
